meta.title: Contact and access
meta.description: Address, map, nearest stations, office hours, and contact form of Al Muttaqin Cultural Center in Matsudo, Chiba.

hero.title: Come and visit us in Matsudo.
hero.description: We are a short walk from Matsudo Station. Write to us, call, or send a WhatsApp message, and we will reply as soon as the office is open.

card.officeHours: The office answers calls and messages on weekdays from 10:00 to 17:00.
card.emailHint: We usually reply within two working days.

map.note: Map data by OpenStreetMap contributors. The exact street address will be published by the committee; the marker currently shows central Matsudo.

access.title: How to get here
access.description: Public transport is the easiest way to reach us. Parking is very limited, especially on Fridays.

tokyo.text: JR Ueno-Tokyo Line to Matsudo, about 30 minutes without a change. Rapid trains also stop at Matsudo.

ueno.text: JR Joban Line local or rapid to Matsudo, about 20 minutes.

kashiwa.text: JR Joban Line toward Ueno, about 10 minutes to Matsudo.

narita.text: Keisei Line to Keisei-Takasago or Aoto, then change for Matsudo via Shin-Keisei or JR Joban Line. Allow about 80 minutes.

parking.title: Parking
parking.body: Only a few car spaces are available and none on Fridays or during events. Nearby paid car parks can be found around Matsudo Station.
parking.bike: Bicycle parking is available next to the entrance.

office.title: Office hours
office.description: When the secretariat can answer calls, messages, and visits.

form.title: Send us a message
form.description: For visits, media requests, volunteering, or partnerships. Urgent prayer-time questions are answered faster on WhatsApp.

tips.0: Choose a subject so the right person on the board receives your message.
tips.1: For school or group visits, tell us the date, group size, and preferred language.
tips.2: Your data is used only to reply to you and is never shared with third parties.

form.name: Name
form.subject: Subject
form.messageHint: At least 10 characters. Please include dates or details that help us answer.

errors.turnstile: Spam check failed. Please reload the page and try again.

success.title: Thank you, your message has been received.
success.body: The office will reply by email, usually within two working days.
success.fallbackTitle: One more step to send your message
success.fallbackBody: Online delivery is not active yet. Send the same message to us through WhatsApp or email with one tap; nothing needs to be retyped.

social.title: Social media
social.description: Daily updates, recorded lectures, and event photos.
